name: Vietnamese (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in Vietnamese offered by the Department of Southeast Asian Studies. Once certified, the certificate is listed on student transcripts.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester

With adviser approval, up to two advanced non-L5 Yale courses conducted in Vietnamese may count (e.g., VIET 4700 or VIET 4710 graded pass/fail, or an advanced seminar); only one pass/fail independent study course may count
Up to two study-abroad credits taught in Vietnamese may be substituted with adviser approval

requirements.name: Courses beyond L4
requirements.description: Four courses beyond the L4 level in Vietnamese (beyond VIET 1420). At least two must be Yale courses designated L5 (e.g., VIET 1500, VIET 1600, or VIET 4600).
